title: AI Code Annotation Schema
description: Standardized annotation format for enhancing AI code understanding

annotation_format.comment_style: Language-appropriate comments at top of file

@ai-purpose.description: One-line description of module's primary responsibility
guidelines: Focus on WHAT it does, not HOW
@ai-purpose.example: @ai-purpose: Vector storage interface for semantic search over memories

@ai-dependencies.description: Comma-separated list of external dependencies (packages, services, databases)

@ai-related.description: Comma-separated list of related module paths

@ai-key-functions.description: Comma-separated list of most important functions/classes

@ai-data-flow.description: High-level description of how data moves through this module
@ai-data-flow.example: @ai-data-flow: User prompt → RAG search → specialist activation → context injection → final prompt

@ai-extension-point.description: How developers can extend or modify this module
@ai-extension-point.example: @ai-extension-point: Add new specialists to brain/specialists/ directory for auto-discovery

@ai-activation-trigger.description: For specialists: what condition triggers activation

@ai-priority.description: For specialists: context injection priority (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)
@ai-priority.example: @ai-priority: HIGH (injected early in prompt after system notices)

@ai-tool-use-pattern.description: For bidirectional specialists: how LLM invokes the tool
@ai-tool-use-pattern.example: @ai-tool-use-pattern: LLM emits XML tag mid-response → specialist executes → results injected → LLM continues

@ai-warning.description: Warns against common mistakes or anti-patterns specific to this codebase
@ai-warning.example: @ai-warning: Don't run 'make html' manually - docs build automatically in Docker (frontend/Dockerfile)

@ai-endpoints.description: For API modules: comma-separated list of exposed endpoints

best_practices.placement: Add annotations immediately after docstring, before imports

specialist_plugin: # @ai-extension-pattern: How this follows the plugin architecture
